responsibility: Attach opt-in specialist services to the Dysium backend-first compiler without making them global runtime dependencies.

integrations.name: AI upload form
integrations.job: Accept uploads through a lean form, extract suggestions through an AI or parser backend, and require review before deterministic posting.
securityContract: Uploads are stored through Frappe-controlled file permissions.
AI extraction returns a proposal and does not write business records directly.
A human review or explicit workflow approval is required before posting.
The visible form exposes only upload, review, correction, and submit controls.

integrations.name: Structured importer
integrations.job: Import CSV or workbook data through explicit header validation, typed row normalization, preview, and deterministic apply steps.
securityContract: Required workbook or CSV headers are validated before records are changed.
Import preview and apply are separate service calls.
Relative dates stay relative unless the workbook supplies calendar dates.
Imported rows produce auditable counts, errors, and skipped-record reasons.

dependencyPolicy: Install frontend/backend packages only when this integration is selected or inferred by intent.
